d:
---
This is my first time translating ever, so please feel free to complain and point out my mistakes

I used a free online translation service for this. I tried my best to correct some grammar issues and text problems, I also added some of my own creative liberties in some of the speech bubbles. If anyone noticed, I threw in a lenny face-type emote on page 3 for one of the minions since the original emote got murdered by the ai tool. I also had to manually draw the text on Shion's body on page 33 as the tool replaced it with words and I didn't want to just delete the text and leave the body writing on her empty.

It took me a couple hours to do this, so I will probably work on the other set the author posted on Pixiv that is related to Shion.
n: [Doujinshi] [Kataokasan] Overwatch: The Wretched Remains of Shion
